description: The plot illustrates the performance of three different methods, On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT, with respect to temperature, comparing their accuracy as measured by Pass@8. The x-axis represents temperature, with a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis represents accuracy, with a linear scale ranging from 62.5 to 80.0, and tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The On-policy RL line is depicted in orange with a triangle marker and a solid line style, starting at around 62.5 at a temperature of 0.1, increasing to 70.0 at 0.3, then fluctuating between 67.5 and 72.5 before rising to approximately 72.5 at a temperature of 1.0. The LUFFY line is shown in red with a star marker and a solid line style, beginning at around 75.0 at a temperature of 0.1, peaking at 80.0 at 0.4, then remaining relatively stable with minor fluctuations between 77.5 and 80.0 across the temperature range. The SFT line is represented in blue with a triangle marker and a solid line style, starting at around 75.0 at a temperature of 0.1, decreasing to 72.5 at 0.2, then generally trending upwards with some fluctuations to approximately 75.0 at a temperature of 1.0.
